note_on_fixed_cells_vs_gold: Not a held-out test: the fixed cells were drawn from these same explications, so agreement shows only that the rows don't contradict their sources. INTENSITY +1 comes from row 5's degree law (F125); WRITTEN_BY_DEGREE_LAW_NOT_IN_EXPLICATION marks explications with no VERY. CAN and HAPPEN are fixed only for Fear readings; sad, concerned, sadness and sorrow must find theirs through their own fields.
projection_choices_in_the_gold: Every non-substantive prime an explication contains is written for the word, whatever its scope in the explication, except GOOD (next).

GOOD is the felt valence (Q1). It is read from the feeling line only ('feels something good/bad'); a feeling line with no quality leaves GOOD empty. An evaluation inside the thought stays in the derivation.
Substantives are roles unless they head the word's own denotation (Q2).
'know if' is written as IF, though CH's IF box shows only conditionals.
'sometimes' (CH: a portmanteau of a quantifier and time) is QUANTITY and WHEN; 'some' is QUANTITY.
'will' and the past tense ('happened') write nothing; neither is a prime.
'think like this', 'like this' and 'feels like this' count as LIKE.
'this', 'these' have no coordinate (THIS is not in the basis).
'very' writes INTENSITY: the basis has no VERY, and F125 makes INTENSITY the mark of degree-bearing content, 'not very bad' included.
'maybe' writes MAYBE; 'can', 'can't' and 'could' write CAN, with NOT for the negation.
'have to' writes NOT and CAN: the chart glosses it as 'can't not'.
'would' writes IF: W1992's prime list pairs them as one meta-predicate ('if/would'). Only W1990b's frightened uses it here.
'for some time' writes nothing ((FOR) SOME TIME has no coordinate); 'for a long time' writes LONG_TIME.

Under option B of the CAUSE decision, each 'because' is sorted: CAUSE when a causer's DO or HAPPEN brings about a change in another participant, BECAUSE otherwise. Every 'because' in these explications is a thought-to-feeling or reason link, so the gold is the same under A and B; under B, CAUSE is one more open field.
unproven_versus_uncertain: An open field is unproven, not necessarily uncertain: 33 of afraid's 40 open coordinates are silent in its published explication, and stay open only until a scoped silence law (F101, checked against the explications) proves it for the class. That leaves afraid 7 real choices.
